description: This file provides functions and types for managing and executing OpenShell commands via SSH, including command resolution, building command arguments, and creating SSH sessions.

classes.name: OpenShellExecContext
classes.description: Type defining the context for executing OpenShell commands, including configuration, sandbox name, and optional timeout.

methods.name: setBundledOpenShellCommandResolverForTest
methods.description: Sets a test resolver function for the bundled OpenShell command.

methods.name: resolveBundledOpenShellCommand
methods.description: Resolves the path to the bundled OpenShell command, using cache and test resolver if available.

methods.name: resolveOpenShellCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command to use for OpenShell, defaulting to the bundled command if input is 'openshell'.

methods.name: buildOpenShellBaseArgv
methods.description: Builds the argument vector for the OpenShell command based on configuration.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a shell-escaped string of command arguments.

methods.name: runOpenShellCli
methods.description: Executes the OpenShell CLI with specified parameters and returns the result.

methods.name: createOpenShellSshSession
methods.description: Creates an SSH session for OpenShell sandbox based on the current context.
